name: @wcgw/vibe-check-mcp
stderr:
Usage: vibe-check-mcp <command> [options]

Commands:
  up          Start the local hub and print the setup steps for one project and agent. Reuses a hub that is already running on the port.
  hub         Run only the long-running local hub that browser widgets send snapshots to.
  setup       Install the widget, generate VibeCheckDevtools.tsx, register the project, and configure one agent client.
  doctor      Read-only check of the hub, the browser project, and the agent watcher.
  stats       Print the project's verified fixes, regressions, and measured improvements.
  register    Record where a project lives, so the hub saves its history in <root>/.vibecheck/state.json.
  unregister  Remove a project from the registry. Its .vibecheck/state.json is left in place.
  connect     Stdio MCP bridge to the hub. Your agent client starts it from its MCP config; set VIBE_CHECK_HUB_URL there for a non-default hub.

Environment:
  VIBE_CHECK_PORT             hub and up port (default 4200)
  VIBE_CHECK_HOST             hub and up bind address (default 127.0.0.1)
  VIBE_CHECK_ALLOWED_ORIGINS  extra browser origins for hub and up, comma separated
  VIBE_CHECK_HUB_URL          hub URL for connect, doctor, and stats
  VIBE_CHECK_REGISTRY_PATH    project registry file (default ~/.vibecheck/projects.json)

Run "vibe-check-mcp <command> --help" for a command's options, or "vibe-check-mcp --version" for the version.

Agent clients start the MCP bridge with "vibe-check-mcp connect".
